title: Learn {name}, *two ways*
text: Guided videos and a hands-on proof of concept for {name}-app, step-by-step guides for {name}-pkg.

tabs.label: Guided Videos
tabs.text: Watch the full {name}-app playlist for a step-by-step introduction, from loading medical images and radiomics feature extraction to model training and results analysis.

tabs.label: Proof of Concept
tabs.text: Reproduce a published radiomics study on public data: predict lung metastases in soft-tissue sarcoma patients from pre-treatment PET, CT and MRI scans of the TCIA Soft-Tissue-Sarcoma collection.

items.title: Single Scan Extraction
items.text: Explore one patient's scans and extract radiomics features from a single image.

items.title: Radiomics Pre-checks
items.text: Load the dataset in the DataManager and review it before extraction.

items.title: Batch Extraction
items.text: Extract features for every patient and imaging modality in one run.

items.title: Learning Module
items.text: Train and evaluate models that predict lung metastasis risk.

items.title: Results Analysis
items.text: Compare modalities and feature families against the original study.

tracks.title: Learn {name}-pkg, step by step
tracks.text: Follow focused, practical guides to get {name}-pkg running, from pip install to radiomics feature extraction and model training.

items.title: Install {name}-pkg (Python)
items.text: Set up a virtual environment and install {name}-pkg via pip in minutes.

items.title: Prepare your data
items.text: Prepare and organize your DICOM and NIfTI scans with segmentation masks.

items.title: Configure Extraction
items.text: Set up IBSI-compliant radiomics feature extraction parameters.

items.title: Data Manager
items.text: Convert your DICOM and NIfTI data into manageable binary files.

items.title: Batch Extractor
items.text: Run batch extraction on individual scans or entire datasets.

items.title: Machine Learning
items.text: Train and evaluate machine learning models using the extracted features.
